What connects the ecosystem

A quieter, shared wallet

Six keyboard-accessible tabs, icon controls and tooltips. Panels match each site's colors and light or dark theme; account tools and detailed estimates stay out of the way until needed.

Automatic views, explicit spending

Public wallet views update through account changes and periodic refreshes. There is no public-sync button. Sending, tipping, trading and signing still require approval; no keys or sign-in sessions are shared with embeds.

One source for each operation

Gold handles Ethereum and FTHG. Notes handles native FTH balances and notes. Exchange executes swaps; World gameplay funds and Exchange trading holdings remain separate from spendable wallet funds.

How the network works today

EthereumGold APIsFTHG and supported native ETH reads belong to Gold. Actual Ethereum transfers require wallet approval and gas.
↔
Native economyNotes APIsFTH$, FTHX, notes, wallet operations and conserved ledger balances. Dollar API URLs remain compatibility aliases.
↔
ApplicationsConnected sitesWorld, Exchange, X, Sites, Stats and Wallet share services without sharing private keys.

The FTH$ network uses a writer and validating read replicas with signed blocks and daily files. It is an application-ledger network, not a deployed Layer 3 rollup. No rollup settlement or decentralized consensus is claimed.

Only the configured origin and backing wallets authorize FTHG reserve reconciliation through Gold. Pending off-chain obligations are not Ethereum transfers. New FTH$ bridge issuance and staking rewards are closed; pools and payments use existing authorized balances.

Work together in Featheral App

Featheral App is the mobile-first Foundation intranet for volunteers, interns and managers. Create a World profile, request access, then wait for administrator approval. Membership, divisions, teams, roles and progression levels are assigned through protected Admin user management.

Foundation, division, team and direct conversations keep work private. Chat, private files, shared notes, one-to-one calls and screen sharing support delivery. Missions progress from ready to in progress, evidence-backed review and manager approval. Browser push is opt-in and requires operator configuration; private content is not cached for offline use. Existing World gameplay conversations and personal messages stay in World.

Featheral Silver (FTHS), also known as Featheral Salary, is a native whole-unit note. Completing work does not automatically mint salary. Administrators explicitly approve each grant; grants and membership changes are auditable. Silver has no guaranteed wage, USD peg, return or market price. Notes lists Silver; Exchange can execute FTHS/FTHX trades only after an administrator funds real liquidity. No FTHX is automatically minted or moved.

One ecosystem, independent businesses

Current phase: World building. Perfect every site as a useful standalone product, validate sustainable revenue, and keep connecting businesses where the integration creates measurable value. Web3 governance for future innovators is the long-term direction, not a deployed DAO or a token-holder entitlement.

  1. Now - World building and product quality: refine World exploration, settlements, effects, scarcity and unified market liquidity; improve every site's mobile UX, accessibility, reliability, documentation and support. Exit gate: critical flows pass tests and users can complete each product's core task independently.
  2. Next - Standalone revenue: validate demand and transparent paid offers, measure retention, operating costs and contribution margin, and publish launch criteria. Exit gate: paying users, reliable fulfillment and a credible path to sustainable unit economics for each business.
  3. Then - Business synergy: connect identity, publishing, payments, creator discovery and reporting with explicit consent and separate balances. Exit gate: integrations improve conversion or retention without making standalone products dependent on one another.
  4. Future - Accountable Web3 governance: publish proposals, decisions and budgets; pilot community participation, then consider decentralized controls only after security audits, legal review and clear authority, conflict-of-interest and appeal rules.

Roadmap gates, not promised dates. Proposed offers are not claims of current revenue or profitability. Each product should earn its place through customer value, not token-price appreciation.
